newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS AND DECIDE TO FIELD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS AND DECIDE TO FIELD.

text.p: Indian captain Sachin Tendulkar won the toss and chose to field on the opening day of the first test against South Africa on Thursday.
South Africa: Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Hansie Cronje (captain), Daryll Cullinan, Herschelle Gibbs, Brian McMillan, Dave Richardson, Shaun Pollock, Lance Klusener, Allan Donald.
India: Woorkeri Raman, Vikram Rathore, Saurav Ganguly, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Mohammad Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, David Johnson, Venkatesh Prasad.
